title: GTA 6 First Day Sales: $3.79 Billion in One Day (More Than Avengers: Endgame's Entire Box Office)
description:
GTA 6 first day sales hit an estimated $3.79 billion in retail sales, Rockstar Games said on Nov. 20, 2026, one day after Grand Theft Auto VI launched.

The numbers, side by side:
- GTA VI launched Nov. 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar estimates $3.79 billion in retail sales through the end of launch day (company estimate, preorders included in some reports).
- GTA V made about $800 million on its first day in 2013, so GTA VI is almost five times that.
- Avengers: Endgame grossed about $2.8 billion in theaters over its entire run.
- About 32.5 million copies were sold before the game came out.
- An outside estimate from Sensor Tower, published before Rockstar's figure, was lower: about $2.36 billion.

Sources:
- AP via ABC News (Nov. 20, 2026), GTA VI sets record with $3.79B in first-day retail sales: https://abcnews.com/US/wireStory/grand-theft-auto-vi-sets-record-379b-day-138335808
- Fox Business (Nov. 21, 2026), GTA VI shatters entertainment records with $3.79B debut: https://www.foxbusiness.com/entertainment/grand-theft-auto-vi-shatters-entertainment-records-staggering-3-79b-debut
- ABC News / GMA (Nov. 20, 2026), GTA VI breaks first-day sales record: https://abcnews.com/GMA/Culture/grand-theft-auto-vi-breaks-1st-day-sales-record/story?id=138328412
- Take-Two Interactive, Form 8-K exhibit (Sept. 2013), GTA V $800 million first day: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000946581/000110465913070819/a13-20938_1ex99d1.htm
- Engadget (2013), GTA V makes over $800 million on day one: https://www.engadget.com/2013-09-18-grand-theft-auto-5-makes-off-with-over-800-million-on-day-one.html
- Box Office Mojo, Avengers: Endgame worldwide gross: https://www.boxofficemojo.com/title/tt4154796/

questions.q: How much did GTA 6 make on its first day?
questions.a: Rockstar Games estimated $3.79 billion in retail sales for Grand Theft Auto VI through the end of launch day, Nov. 19, 2026 (announced Nov. 20).

questions.q: Did GTA 6 make more than GTA 5 on day one?
questions.a: Yes. GTA V made about $800 million on its first day in 2013, so GTA VI's estimated $3.79 billion is almost five times as much.

questions.q: How many copies of GTA 6 were sold before release?
questions.a: About 32.5 million copies were sold before the game came out, according to AP and Fox Business reporting on Rockstar's figures.
